description: Native folder-open dialog for the web client served by the in-process server (ADR 0013). The main window loads http://127.0.0.1:<ephemeral port> — a remote context to Tauri, so IPC is unavailable unless granted here. The grant is loopback-only (a `--connect` remote server's origin gets no IPC) and minimal: just the open dialog, no fs access, no core surface.
